title: Boundary Score Matching for Functional-Geometry Counterfactuals
falsification_prediction: Post-train the same continuous-action π0.5 initialization on BoundaryFlip-RoboTwin pairs and compare ordinary imitation, global feasibility supervision, whole-chunk preference tuning, and the proposed objective on held-out task and geometry families. If the mechanism works, edited-scene success rises and invalid-mode execution falls relative to ordinary imitation, while alternative-positive coverage and worst-mode success remain higher and complement score drift remains lower than under global and whole-chunk shaping. The load-bearing variable is the mean held-out boundary margin M_B = E[d_θ]; permuting violation masks or positive/invalid pair identities while holding data volume and all loss weights fixed should collapse the edited-scene success and mode-coverage advantage, not merely change M_B. If those permutations preserve the downstream advantage, or if L_alt removal leaves worst-mode success unchanged while coverage is already high, boundary-local credit and alternative-positive preservation are not the operative causes. As mandatory pre-training gates, report eligibility among all compiler-attempted pairs, the complete mask-length and roster-size distributions, and each excluded pair's exclusion reason plus frozen-policy edited-scene success and invalid-mode execution; no downstream mechanism claim is eligible unless these gates show that proper boundary runs and alternative-mode rosters occur beyond a negligible selected subset.
core_mechanism: Build BoundaryFlip-RoboTwin as a modest scripted extension of RoboTwin 2.0: for each eligible episode, retain a successful normalized action chunk a0 in scene g+ and enumerate the registered discrete values of every exposed collision-mesh parameter, choosing the one-parameter edit δg that uses the fewest compiler increments while making a0 fail in g−; ties are broken by parameter identifier and then signed value, while language, terminal object relation and pose, robot and object initial states, camera, materials, background, controller seed, and all other geometry remain fixed. Eligibility also requires that g− remains solvable and that the deterministic trace yields a nonempty proper violation run, 0<sum(M)<T. From simulator clearance and contact traces, define v_t as penetration, prohibited contact, or kinematic infeasibility at control step t, let V be the first contiguous true run, and let disjoint masks P, M, and S denote steps before V, in V, and after V, so the additive squared denoising error obeys E_full=E_P+E_M+E_S exactly as loss accounting under these masks. The context c− contains only the policy's RGB views, proprioception, and unchanged instruction; δg, v_t, M, and compiler mode identities are training-time supervision and are never policy inputs. For diffusion index j and Gaussian noise ε, define x_j(a)=α_j a+σ_j ε and the computable masked score surrogate r_θ(a,c,M) as the negative mean masked denoising error, estimated with shared j and ε for compared actions and n_noise=1 draw per SGD occurrence by default, increased only to fill otherwise idle accelerator capacity at fixed batch size. For every edited scene, rerun the RoboTwin task controller across its finite discrete grasp, approach-homotopy, and contact-order seed tuples; each tuple is one compiler mode_id, and its successful normalized chunks form the complete feasible roster P_i={p_ik}. The loader samples mode_id uniformly and then a trajectory uniformly inside that mode for the boundary loss, while also emitting the packed complete roster and validity mask. With frozen base θ0, the boundary margin is the positive model-change score minus the invalid model-change score on the same M indices, and L_flip is the negative log-sigmoid of β times that margin. M localizes which residual coordinates enter L_flip; because the action head shares parameters across time, it does not guarantee that an update changes predictions only inside M. The complement fidelity term L_out therefore averages teacher distillation to θ0 over P∪S for a0 and every roster chunk and the retention panel measures residual spillover. L_alt is the maximum across mode_ids of each mode's mean ordinary full-chunk denoising loss; exactly tied maxima contribute their mean gradient, so no implementation-specific tie selects one mode. The post-training objective is L_base+λ_flip L_flip+λ_out L_out+λ_alt L_alt. Set β to the reciprocal standard deviation of the frozen raw positive-minus-invalid masked score gap on the calibration split and emit a calibration error if that deviation is zero. Match λ_flip and λ_alt to the L2 gradient norm of L_base at θ0; then take one noncommitting probe update with the actual base optimizer using L_base plus those two calibrated terms and match λ_out at the probe, because squared distillation has zero gradient at θ0. Any required zero auxiliary gradient emits a calibration error rather than a checkpoint. Select the resulting named λ values only on held-out geometry families. The shared BoundaryFlip retention panel reports edited-scene success, invalid-mode execution, complement score drift, compiler-roster coverage, worst-mode success, and ordinary RoboTwin 2.0 success under matched pair seeds. At deployment the post-trained policy runs the unchanged diffusion or flow sampler from RGB, proprioception, and language, so no simulator oracle field or mode identity enters the policy interface. To instantiate C04 literally rather than by temporal analogy, perform T matched diagnostic replays per accepted pair in g−, restoring the g+ collision geometry only during control interval t, define q_t as the resulting decrease in cumulative downstream violations relative to the unmodified g− replay, and require q_t>0 exactly on M and q_t=0 on P∪S, making M an intervention-identified high-impact minority that receives the preference residual while the low-impact bulk is protected by distillation.
core_mechanism_steps:
1. Add a BoundaryFlip compiler to existing RoboTwin 2.0 task assets. Enumerate the registered discrete values of each exposed collision-mesh parameter, choose the valid-in-g+, invalid-in-g−, solvable-in-g− edit requiring the fewest compiler increments, and break ties by parameter identifier and signed value while copying every named confound byte-for-byte; output g+, g−, δg, a0, and the pair audit.
2. Replay a0 in both scenes with identical simulator settings and form the first maximal contiguous violation mask M with prefix P and suffix S; accept only records satisfying 0<sum(M)<T, and output the traces, masks, and eligibility record.
3. Rerun the scripted controller over every registered grasp, approach-homotopy, and contact-order seed tuple in g−. Treat the exact tuple as mode_id, group successful normalized chunks by that identifier, output the complete roster, and discard pairs with no positive mode before training.
4. Extend the continuous-action VLA loader to emit c−, a0, M, P, S, a uniformly selected mode_id followed by a uniformly selected p_ik within that mode, and a packed complete roster with a validity mask; use the same diffusion index and noise draw for every compared action and retain the base model's action normalization.
5. Compute r_θ, the frozen-reference boundary margin d_θ, and L_flip. Only M coordinates enter the preference residual; do not claim that shared-parameter updates affect only M, and measure or penalize their output spillover through S6 and S8.
6. Compute L_out by averaging θ-to-θ0 denoiser distillation on P∪S for a0 and every valid roster chunk. Compute each mode's mean ordinary full-chunk denoising loss and take their maximum as L_alt, averaging gradients across exact maximum ties; output both auxiliary losses and gradients.
7. On the calibration split, reject a zero frozen gap standard deviation, set β from the nonzero deviation, and gradient-match λ_flip and λ_alt to L_base at θ0. Take one noncommitting probe update with the actual optimizer and those terms, gradient-match λ_out at the probe, reject any required zero auxiliary norm, then select the named weights on held-out geometry families and post-train jointly with L_base.
8. Evaluate ordinary imitation post-training, the simple global feasibility objective, whole-chunk preference tuning, largest-cluster inference selection, and the proposed checkpoint on the identical held-out pair-seed table; output the BoundaryFlip retention panel and ordinary RoboTwin 2.0 success.
9. Run within-stratum mask permutation, bijective pair-identity permutation, no-L_out, and no-L_alt interventions through otherwise identical training and the full closed-loop sampler; output edited success, invalid-mode execution, complement drift, roster coverage, and worst-mode success. 10. With the eligible pair table, P/M/S masks, data volume, seeds, optimizer, and calibrated weights fixed, compare masked score preference against a masked supervised local-feasibility penalty, then hold the score-preference signal family fixed and compare M-localized against whole-chunk application, reporting the full BoundaryFlip retention panel for both axes.
core_mechanism_reasoning:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES ledger:
P1 — A minimal collision-mesh edit can flip a previously successful chunk at a localized clearance/contact boundary while leaving the task solvable; simulator collision traces make this constructible, but its prevalence is untested — falsification target.
P2 — The first contiguous simulator violation run is a useful causal credit unit for receding-horizon policy repair; deterministic replay supports temporal attribution, but whether later closed-loop success is controlled by that unit is untested — falsification target.
P3 — A masked denoising-error difference is a useful surrogate for changing conditional action mass near the violated segment; diffusion training supplies this local score object, but its alignment with execution is untested — falsification target.
P4 — The scripted controller's discrete grasp, approach-homotopy, and contact-order seeds cover the mode strata claimed by the paper; coverage is exact only relative to that compiler roster, not all physically possible trajectories.
OBSERVATION-MODEL — Pairs are deliberately selected conditional on a validity flip and on finding at least one edited-scene solution, so they are not an unbiased sample of ordinary RoboTwin episodes; the claim is restricted to the compiler-defined eligible-pair distribution and tested on held-out task and geometry families.
ESTIMAND — Over eligible pairs emitted by the BoundaryFlip compiler, randomized admissible initial states, the compiler-enumerated feasible-mode roster, and policy sampling randomness, estimate edited-scene task success, invalid-mode execution probability, complement score drift, per-roster-mode success, and the fraction of roster modes reached by successful rollouts.
BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT: the runnable naive method marks every coordinate of a0 negative in g− and every coordinate of one edited-scene solution positive in a whole-chunk diffusion preference loss. Branch (i): it silently assumes every timestep of a failed chunk and every unselected action mode is invalid, which is false because the same minimal pair certifies a shared-valid complement and the compiler exposes several feasible modes; our exact masked error decomposition, complement distillation, and worst-mode positive loss confront that failure directly. The nearest textbook tool is contrastive learning with hard negatives, but the domain-specific structure is a receding-horizon continuous diffusion chunk whose negative label changes under one geometry intervention at a simulator-observed temporal boundary while a finite compiler-defined multimodal support must be retained, so unstructured negative sampling or classifier guidance does not solve the coupled localization-and-support constraint.
BLOCK 3 — The two selected gaps share the same paired rollout, mask, and compiler mode roster: the method writes a local score margin into that object and the diagnostic reads the same object to separate correction from mode collapse, so a second policy module would be redundant. Global feasibility regularization, differentiable collision-cost guidance, whole-chunk preference optimization, and largest-cluster inference selection were rejected because they regress to occupied global collision/guidance/selection nodes or sacrifice causal localization and minority-mode retention; the saturated C04 lane is defended by the exact temporal error decomposition rather than the generic act of partitioning. NOVELTY SCOPE — All differentiation and novelty language is restricted to the retrieved-evidence boundary: with only 2 of 25 primary records available in full text, six unresolved host references, and zero arXiv collision coverage, no exact-mechanism novelty claim is made until those primary records and the missing collision channel are checked.
